test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

The letter has been written by the manager carefully.

options.text: The manager was writing the letter carefully.
The manager will write the letter carefully.
The manager is writing the letter carefully.
The manager has written the letter carefully.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The letter has been written by the manager carefully."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the original subject "the manager" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "has been written" to the active verb form "has written" (present perfect active).
 
• Ensure the adverb "carefully" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The manager has written the letter carefully."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The manager was writing the letter carefully." – Incorrect tense (past continuous).
 
• **Option 2: **"The manager will write the letter carefully." – Incorrect tense (future simple).
 
• **Option 3: **"The manager is writing the letter carefully." – Incorrect tense (present continuous).
